title: Syria Update — Jun 02, 2026
summary: Syria's transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa is set to attend the June 15–17 G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains — Syria's first-ever G7 participation, framed around its bid as a Hormuz-alternative transit corridor. The IDF struck anti-ship missile depots near Latakia and Tartus on May 30, killing one civilian, marking the first significant Israeli strike in Syria in weeks; two new map-line entries and a Latakia conflict point added. The UN formally ended its 11-year Turkey-Syria cross-border humanitarian aid route in late May as WFP emergency food cuts (50%) took effect. Six new daily event files cover May 28–June 2; the KPI counter updated to 541 days since Assad's fall; US forces in northeast Syria updated to ~700 following mid-April drawdown.

title: Syria Update — May 25, 2026
summary: The EU Council on May 18 renewed Assad-era sanctions while delisting Syria's Ministries of Defence and Interior — enabling direct EU engagement with the transitional government's security sector — building on the May 11 restoration of the EU-Syria Cooperation Agreement. Transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa issued a customs decree on May 22 reinforcing Syria's ban on Israeli-origin goods, signaling continued policy continuity on Israel despite diplomatic opening with the West. A car bomb in Damascus killed at least one person on May 22. Turkey captured 10 ISIS operatives inside Syria on May 23 amid continued counter-terrorism pressure in the northeast. SNHR published an analysis noting the EU's May 18 delisting marks a new phase of institutional engagement. Six new events cover May 18–25; KPIs, map-points, and meta updated.

title: Syria Update — May 17, 2026
summary: The EU Council reinstated the full EU-Syria Cooperation Agreement on May 11 — suspended since 2011 — pledging €280 million in aid and opening the first EU-Syria High-Level Political Dialogue. US Secretary of State Rubio met Syrian FM Asaad al-Shaibani in Antalya on May 15 to confirm comprehensive sanctions relief, in one of the highest-level US-Syria diplomatic engagements in 15 years. The UN Security Council was briefed that Syria's 2026 humanitarian appeal is only 16% funded ($480M of $2.9B), forcing WFP to halve food assistance to 650,000 people. Israeli forces raided villages in Quneitra governorate on May 16, ransacking homes and firing artillery at agricultural land. Syria reported ~120,000 voluntary refugee returns from Lebanon in the first four months of 2026. Six new events cover May 10–17; KPIs, map-lines, map-points, political figures, and economic data updated.

title: Syria Update — May 9, 2026
summary: Syria's security services dismantled a Hezbollah-linked assassination cell targeting senior transitional officials on May 5–6, arresting at least 11 people in nationwide raids. On May 2, Israel launched over 20 airstrikes across Syrian territory — including near the presidential palace in Damascus — and fired artillery into Quneitra while warning Syrian forces to halt operations against the Druze community. The first public trial of an Assad-era official (Atef Najib, accused of ordering 2011 Daraa torture) opened on April 26. On May 3, the UN formally ended its 11-year cross-border humanitarian aid operation from Turkey into Syria after more than 65,000 delivery journeys, as Syria and Turkey develop commercial routes under the transitional government. Six new map-line entries document Israeli strike trajectories across Syrian territory, and the days-since-regime-collapse KPI has been updated to 517 days.
